items.html:
Implemented in crates/treams-core/src/lattice/reciprocal.rs:

  • On-plane spherical reciprocal polynomials skip vanishing powers while retaining linear terms for normal derivatives.
  • On-plane outer order loop stops at floor((l−|m|+I[N>0])/2).
  • Added exact comparison against the unrestricted polynomial for values and derivatives through degree 12, including tiny off-plane displacements.

Formatted. Focused test compilation was blocked by concurrent S-matrix signature changes; no lattice compiler errors appeared. No benchmarks run.

Existing relevant checks include sums_match_high_precision_references, plane_and_axis_sums_do_not_depend_on_the_split, ewald_complete_derivative, and sums_tend_to_their_values_on_the_plane_and_axis.

No Ewald zero shortcut added: preserving threshold detection requires more care.
